lines.en: I tread rubble in the fog.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片在黑石上擦响。
lines.en: My scales rasp on the dark stone.
I step back, keeping distance.
I move along the cliff edge.
I level my bow slowly.
I walk from one patch of fog to another.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在石面上打滑。
lines.en: My claws slip on the stone.
I try to make no sound.
I head for higher ground.
I drag my tail across the stone bridge.

lines.zh: 我在石柱后停住，侧耳听。
lines.en: I stop behind the pillar and listen.
I go on, feeling my way.
I stand in the fog, bow in hand.
Light seeps between my scales.
I draw the string once.
I listen to the fog.
My tail coils around the pillar.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很轻，弓弦也放轻了。
lines.en: My breathing is light, and so is my bowstring.
Fog flows along the ground.
I count the wind below the cliff.
I glance into the deep gorge below.
I straighten my arrow's fletching.
In the mist only your outline shows.
My bow is already raised.
Don't take another step.
At this range, I'm confident.
I can hear your boots.
I know your kind of visitor.
There's no cover behind you.
I aim slowly at your chest.
The fog will hide my position.
I raise a hand for you to see.
The hit threw off my aim.
A cut has opened in my scales.
I fall back at once and draw again.
This pain is little.
I grip the bow tighter.
I duck behind the pillar.
I can keep shooting.
I've marked your range.
The fog hides me again.
The edges of my scales are scorched.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子能闻出火药味。
lines.en: I can smell gunpowder on you.
My hand stays on the arrow.

lines.zh: 我的箭头上还挂着鳞片。
lines.en: Scales still cling to my arrowheads.
I'm more interested in your hands.

lines.zh: 这点东西换不来我一箭。
lines.en: That won't buy one of my arrows.
I approach slowly, bow still up.
I look down at it.
I kick the thing aside.
Put it away; I don't need it.

lines.zh: 我的目光又回到你身上。
lines.en: My gaze returns to you.
I crush a charred rock underfoot.
I open the distance at once.
My scales are hard; don't touch.
I twist away from your hand.
The fog on the ledge is churned.
I raise an arm against your shove.
My tail knocks loose rubble down.
My scales clatter from the bump.
I settle again, bow still in hand.
I hold my bow across my chest.
Another bow appears in the fog.
We lower our arrowheads.
We keep watch at the cliff edge together.
We stand side by side at the cliff.
Let your quiver knock against mine.
We both know the fog's paths.
We lean side by side on the pillar.
In this moment, both bows are lowered.
Tomorrow we each guard a stretch.
The fog thins, and we part.
I pinch it up between two fingers.
Too bright; I don't like it.
One more arrow in my quiver.
I look, then drop it back.
My quiver is worth more than this.
Fog dew clings to it.
This goes under a stone.
I could take this along.
My bow is bound with scorched scale.
It smells foul.
My arrows burn with abyss fire.
I've nocked my arrow.
Good, you'll be my mark.

lines.zh: 我锁定了你的胸口，别动。
lines.en: I have your chest — hold still.
This range suits me.
The fletching quivers.
I start to draw.
Behind you is the gorge.

lines.zh: 鳞片做的箭头，射得很远。
lines.en: Scale-tipped arrows fly far.
You retreat; I adjust too.
The string is drawn to my cheek.
One arrow suffices.
The fog clears; good.
This is your own doing.
I raise the bow slowly.

lines.zh: 你踩碎石的声音我全听着。
lines.en: I hear every stone you crunch.
I calculate the wind's drift.
I draw a little deeper.
You've stepped into the light.
My string is drawn to my ear.
The arrowhead aims at your shoulder.
This range is exactly right.
I release halfway.
Your movements slowed.
I wait one more instant.
The wind drifted; I correct.
The fog lifts; time to draw.
I let my fingers go.
I loose an arrow.
The arrow grazes your pauldron.
I draw another.
You're forced back to the pillar.
I step back two paces and re-aim.
A second arrow follows.
My bow limb raps your wrist.
Stone chips spray at your feet.
I twist clear of your lunge.
The distance opens again.
I raise a hand for you to stop.
An echo comes through the fog.
I slip out to the flank.
This arrow falls from above you.
I take shape out of the fog.
My outline forms in the hot mist.
The Blazezard Archer, in position.
I take the bow from my shoulder.
Light flickers between my scales.
I step onto the ledge, bow raised.
Fog streams around my legs.
First I note my retreat.
It's high here; the view is good.
Your timing is poor.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了看崖上的雾。
lines.en: I look up at the fog over the cliff.
I settle my quiver.

lines.zh: 火焰烧过我的鳞，我退开。
lines.en: Flame scorches my scales and I pull back.

lines.zh: 我从崖上摔下，砸在石上。
lines.en: I fall off the cliff onto stone.

lines.zh: 雾里的水汽太浓，我喘不上。
lines.en: The fog is too thick with water; I can't breathe.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的箭全吹散了。
lines.en: The blast scatters all my arrows.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片在黑石上擦出声。
lines.en: My scales rasp against the black stone.

lines.zh: 那道光让我看不清准星。
lines.en: The light blurs my aim.
Too hungry to draw full.

lines.zh: 雷打在崖上，我的弓弦都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the cliff and numbs my bowstring.
There's no solid ground here.
